title: 第11章 战秦策第12章 为妹妹报仇
slug: 噬神塔第1929章小金的战力
lines: 秦惊蛰手握拐杖，气血涌动，怒意冲天。
当初没有将秦易赶尽杀绝，没想到他居然敢只身一人，杀回青云城。
轰！
与此同时，一道恐怖到令人惊颤的气息，贯穿天地而来。
还有一道匪夷所思的刀光，割裂空间，以肉眼不可见的速度，爆射到了青云城内。
轰！
秦易手持木剑，挥剑格挡。
咔嚓一声，刀光碎裂。
一袭铠甲的秦策，从仙宗回来了。
“秦易，你找死。”
一月之期已到，秦策本以为，秦易被吓破胆，早就躲起来了。
谁能想到，他居然敢杀秦家人。
“策儿，杀了他……”秦惊蛰老爷子看到秦策回归，激动万分。
他能清晰的感应到，秦策已经踏入了炼脉境。
而且，有仙宗的资源倾斜，用不了多久，就能成为秦家历史最强者。
只要秦策在，秦家就能崛起。
轰！
看到父亲秦天龙的尸体后，秦策眼眸猩红，愤怒到了极致。
“该死的家伙，我要将你碎尸万段！”秦策愤怒咆哮。
秦易耸肩，冷冷道：“心痛的滋味好受吗？”
想当初。
自己的妹妹秦欣儿，只是想帮助自己续脉，偷盗了一颗丹药，就被他们找借口暴打致死。
失去亲人的感觉，真的很痛苦。
现在。
秦易就是要让秦策，也感受到这种绝望的滋味。
咔嚓！
秦策手握战刀，浑身气息荡漾，胸口处的六条灵根闪烁着刺眼的光芒。
“你以为，你恢复了修为，就能跟我叫板吗？”
秦策居高临下，俯视着秦易。
“没抢走我的天脉前，你敢这样跟我叫嚣吗？”秦易反击道。
当时的秦易，乃是青云城赫赫有名的超级妖孽。
秦策也只能当个跟屁虫一样，跪舔秦易。
抢夺天脉，是秦策这一生的黑点，他不允许任何人提及。
哪怕，当事人也不行。
“天脉择优而生，在你身上简直就是浪费，在我身上，我能让他发挥出更耀眼的光芒。”
content_en:
Qin Jingzhe held a cane in his hand, his energy and blood surged, and his anger surged to the sky.
He didn't drive Qin Yi to death at first, but he didn't expect that he would dare to fight back to Qingyun City alone.
boom!
At the same time, a horrifying breath penetrated the heaven and earth.
There was also an incredible sword light that split the space and exploded into Qingyun City at a speed invisible to the naked eye.
boom!
Qin Yi held a wooden sword and swung it to block.
There was a click, and the sword shattered into pieces.
Qin Ce, dressed in armor, returned from the Immortal Sect.
"Qin Yi, you are looking for death."
The one-month period has come, and Qin Ce thought that Qin Yi was scared out of his wits and had already hid.
Who would have thought that he would dare to kill the Qin family.
"Ce'er, kill him..." Mr. Qin Jingzhe was extremely excited when he saw Qin Ce's return.
He could clearly sense that Qin Ce had entered the pulse refining realm.
Moreover, with the resources of the Immortal Sect tilted, it won't take long for him to become the strongest in the history of the Qin family.
As long as Qin Ce is around, the Qin family can rise.
boom!
After seeing the body of his father Qin Tianlong, Qin Ce's eyes were scarlet and he was extremely angry.
"Damn it, I'm going to cut you into pieces!" Qin Ce roared angrily.
Qin Yi shrugged and said coldly: "Does the heartache feel good?"
Think back to the beginning.
His sister Qin Xin'er just wanted to help her renew her pulse and stole a pill, so they made excuses and beat her to death.
The feeling of losing a loved one is really painful.
Now.
Qin Yi wanted to make Qin Ce feel this feeling of despair.
Click!
Qin Ce held the sword in his hand, his breath rippling all over his body, and the six spiritual roots on his chest shone with dazzling light.
"Do you think that after you recover your cultivation, you can challenge me?"
Qin Ce was condescending, looking down at Qin Yi.
"Do you dare to yell at me like this before you take away my Tianmai?" Qin Yi countered.
At that time, Qin Yi was a famous super monster in Qingyun City.
Qin Ce could only act like a follower, kneeling down and licking Qin Yi.
"You..."
Seizing the Heavenly Veins was the dark spot of Qin Ce's life, and he did not allow anyone to mention it.
Not even the person involved.
"Tianmai is born by selecting the best. It would be a waste on you. On me, I can make him shine more dazzlingly."
title_en: Chapter 11 Battle with Qin Ce Chapter 12 Revenge for my sister
